title: Medium functional plastic pump bottles for shampoo/conditioner/body wash, etc.
text:
Medium functional plastic pump bottles for shampoo/conditioner/body wash, etc.. There are three medium-sized (i.e. 16 ounce) black lightweight empty plastic bottles in this set. They are labeled for use for shampoo, conditioner, and body wash. There are also three labels provided in case one wanted to re-purpose these for sanitizer, dish soap, or hand soap. If used for something else other than what is on the extra labels or on the bottles, then the label will obviously not be true to what is inside.

The pump mechanism works very well and feels solid. When filling this, it is important that the soap not come above the top rim because the insertion of the pump causes the soap to spill out over the top. It is possible to re-engage the lock on the pump when empty. I would not want to do that with liquid inside.

These work as designed. There are two negatives I see. First, since these are not clear plastic, the soap level CANNOT be viewed through the plastic. Second, these bottles look elegant but because they have the logo "Pr3mium Conc3pt" as a label on the bottle, it is easy to mistake this as a brand of the product inside. I personally would have preferred that label be left off.

The current price of $17.97 is outrageously overpriced for this. I feel a price of $2 per bottle (total of $6 for the set) would be reasonable for these empty and lightweight plastic bottles.
